primary_goal: Provide a local, persistent garage job management application for tracking customers, their vehicles, and work orders from new intake through completion.
target_user: Garage staff managing customer vehicles and repair or service jobs locally.
journeys: A garage staff member launches PitlaneOne Lite using OPEN APP and arrives at the dashboard.
A staff member creates a customer record, then creates one or more vehicles linked to that customer.
A staff member creates a work order for a vehicle, enters the job description, notes, estimated price, and initial NEW status.
A staff member reviews open jobs on the dashboard or work-order board and advances a job from NEW to IN_PROGRESS and then DONE.
A staff member records or updates the final price and job notes before or when completing a work order.
A staff member reviews dashboard counts for open jobs and completed jobs after reopening the locally packaged application.
functional_requirements: Provide local management of customer records.
Provide local management of vehicle records linked to customers.
Provide local management of work orders linked to vehicles.
Allow each work order to store a job description and appendable notes.
Allow each work order to store NEW, IN_PROGRESS, or DONE status.
Allow each work order to store an estimated price and a final price.
Provide a dashboard showing counts of open jobs and completed jobs.
Persist all customer, vehicle, and work-order data in SQLite storage.
Provide an OPEN APP launch mechanism for the packaged local application.
Package the application as a runnable local application.
Test the completed application before delivery.
non_functional_requirements: The application must use a clean responsive web user interface.
The application must operate locally without requiring cloud services or third-party integrations.
SQLite data must persist across normal application restarts.
The packaged application must be runnable by the delivered OPEN APP launch mechanism.
The application should provide clear feedback for successful saves, validation failures, loading activity, backend errors, and destructive actions.

fields.label: Job Description
fields.sample: Diagnose and replace worn front brake pads.

fields.label: Notes
fields.sample: Customer requested a call before any additional work.

validation_rules: A vehicle must be linked to an existing customer and must include registration, make, and model.
A work order must be linked to an existing vehicle and must include a job description.
Work-order status must be one of NEW, IN_PROGRESS, or DONE.
Estimated price and final price are optional nonnegative monetary amounts stored as integer cents.
Notes are appendable so new note text is added without overwriting existing note history.
A customer cannot be deleted while vehicles reference it.
A vehicle cannot be deleted while work orders reference it.
Deletion of a work order requires destructive-action confirmation.
Status changes may only move forward from NEW to IN_PROGRESS and from IN_PROGRESS to DONE; editing without changing status is allowed.
security_privacy: The application is local-only and does not require user authentication because none was requested.
Customer and garage data must remain in the local SQLite database and must not be transmitted to external services.
The application should validate inputs before persistence and display backend failures without exposing unnecessary internal details.
Destructive record deletion must require confirmation.
responsive: Support clean use on desktop and narrow mobile-sized screens.
Adapt tables and work-order board content so essential fields and actions remain usable on smaller screens.
Provide touch-friendly controls and readable form layouts at responsive breakpoints.

states.empty: No records are available yet. Create a record to get started.
states.validation_error: Please correct the highlighted fields and try again.
states.backend_error: The local data operation could not be completed. Please try again.
states.destructive_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this record? This action cannot be undone.

accessibility: Use semantic headings, navigation landmarks, form labels, and button labels.
Ensure all primary actions and forms are usable with keyboard navigation.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate work-order status or validation errors.
Associate validation messages with their relevant input fields.
acceptance_criteria: OPEN APP launches the packaged PitlaneOne Lite application for direct local use.
A user can create, view, edit, and delete customers when no linked vehicles prevent deletion.
A user can create, view, edit, and delete vehicles linked to customers when no linked work orders prevent deletion.
A user can create, view, edit, and delete work orders linked to vehicles.
A work order supports job description, appendable notes, estimated price, final price, and status.
A new work order starts in NEW status and can progress to IN_PROGRESS and then DONE.
The dashboard displays derived counts for open jobs and completed jobs.
Open jobs include work orders in NEW and IN_PROGRESS status, while completed jobs include work orders in DONE status.
Work-order, vehicle, and customer data remains available after closing and reopening the local application.
Invalid required fields and negative price values are rejected with clear validation feedback.
The responsive interface remains usable on desktop and narrow viewport sizes.
The delivered application is tested and packaged as a runnable local application.
assumptions: A customer record needs a name as its primary display value; email and phone are optional contact details.
A vehicle is identified for display by its registration and also stores make and model.
Prices are optional because a garage may create a work order before either an estimate or final charge is known.
Money field samples and stored values are integer cents, so 18000 represents 180.00 in the applicable local currency.
Open jobs are defined as work orders with NEW or IN_PROGRESS status.
The requested workflow is forward-only; completed jobs are not reopened unless requirements are later changed.
Local SQLite storage is located with the packaged application or its local application data and is retained across normal restarts.
uncertainties: The target operating system and packaging format for the delivered OPEN APP launcher were not specified.
The owner did not specify a currency, tax treatment, labor and parts breakdown, appointments, invoices, or customer communications; these are excluded.

provenance.name: owner request
provenance.text: Build a complete local garage job management app called PitlaneOne Lite. It must manage customers, vehicles linked to customers, work orders linked to vehicles, job descriptions, notes, status NEW / IN_PROGRESS / DONE, estimated and final price, and a dashboard showing open and completed jobs. Use persistent SQLite storage and a clean responsive web UI. The final result must be fully tested, packaged as a runnable application, and delivered with OPEN APP so I can launch and use it directly.
